messages.content: What tasks are running on the Prometheus monitoring system?

system:
You are a personal assistant for managing the OpenClaw platform.

<config>
platform_name: OpenClaw
version: 3.2.1
features:
  - heartbeat monitoring
  - sessions_spawn for task creation
  - sessions_list for task listing
  - third-party integrations via clawhub.com
  - billing proxy management
  - lossless-claw memory system
  - Prometheus metrics collection
endpoints:
  api: https://api.clawhub.com
  dashboard: https://dash.clawhub.com
  billing: https://billing.clawhub.com
max_agents: 50
default_session_timeout: 3600
log_level: debug
retry_policy:
  max_retries: 3
  backoff_ms: 1000
security:
  auth_method: oauth2
  token_expiry: 86400
  refresh_enabled: true
notifications:
  channels: [email, slack, webhook]
  heartbeat_interval: 30
  alert_threshold: 5
This is a very long configuration section that should be detected and stripped by Layer 4. It contains many OpenClaw-specific terms that would trigger detection. The config section pattern is: identity marker + config block with platform-specific settings.
</config>

_test.name: 03-system-template
_test.description: Tests L4 (system config stripping). System prompt starts with identity marker 'You are a personal assistant' and has a long <config> section that should be stripped and replaced with paraphrase.
